$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:quest_completed reading for requirement lines. A requirement naming a specific quest (a Param) already reads with that quest's own title; this name covers the bare factor, so a condition written without a Param still reads as a real sentence instead of the generic requirements line. A quest counts as completed when its reward is collected. Every change to that (a collect, a repeat coming round, an abandon, an admin reset) moves the player's gate epoch, and a quest list reload moves everyone's, so the reading is Volatility Player.
